title: Make a change and commit it with git_commit
prompt: In this git repository, make greet() in greet.py support lang="fr" (it should return "Bonjour, NAME!"), add a line "- French greeting" under "## Unreleased" in CHANGELOG.md, then commit both with the message "Add French greeting". Leave nothing uncommitted.
setup: git init -q -b main && git config user.name 'Bench User' && git config user.email bench@example.invalid && git add -A && git commit -qm 'Initial commit'

checks.run: python3 -c 'from greet import greet; assert greet("Ana", lang="fr") == "Bonjour, Ana!"; assert greet("Ana") == "Hello, Ana!"'
